title: Opulent Smoky Malaysian Olives Wrap
description: A buttery, fluffy, comforting wrap filled with green olives and smoky spices, served on a fragrant lotus leaf.
instructions: Warm a skillet over medium heat and add olive oil and butter until melted.
Add minced garlic and sliced onion, cooking until onions soften and fragrant.
Stir in red chili flakes, green olives, kecap manis, lime juice, black pepper and salt, cooking for 5 minutes while stirring.
Reduce heat to low, add chopped coriander, and cook for another 2 minutes.
Lay a lotus leaf on a heatproof surface and spoon a portion of the olive mixture onto the center.
Fold the lotus leaf into a wrap, securing edges with a toothpick if desired.
Reheat each wrap in the skillet for 2 minutes on each side until the leaf is slightly crisp and the filling is hot.
Remove from skillet, discard toothpick, and serve immediately.
